meta.title: 创建退货申请单
meta.changeContent: 清除字段描述中的空格

description: 商家主动发起退货申请，创建退货申请单

children.name: Content-Type
children.description: application/json

children.name: x-lt-openKeyId
children.description: 访问用户隐私数据时的唯一权限标识 openKeyId

children.name: x-lt-timestamp
children.description: 请求时间戳，格式为时间转换为毫秒的值，也就是从1970年1月1日起至今的时间转换为毫秒，如：1583398764000

children.name: x-lt-signature
children.description: 接口签名

children.name: returnDealType
children.description: 发起处理方式:1退货、2报废

children.name: returnModeList
children.description: 仓维度的退货方式列表；当returnDealType=1退货时必填，按仓库维度指定每个仓的退货方式；当returnDealType=2报废时，不传

children.name: returnAddressId
children.description: 计划退货详细地址Id；当distributionType=1-SHEIN合作物流时必填；

children.name: snapshotVersion
children.description: 地址快照版本；当distributionType=1-SHEIN合作物流时必填

children.name: distributionType
children.description: 退货方式，必填；1-SHEIN合作物流；4-自提

children.name: returnExpressCompanyCode
children.description: 退货物流公司代码；当distributionType=1-SHEIN合作物流时必填

children.name: returnExpressCompanyName
children.description: 退货物流公司名称；当distributionType=1-SHEIN合作物流时必填

children.name: warehouseId
children.description: SHEIN仓库id，必填；对应skuInfoList中warehouseInfoList的仓库维度

children.name: returnReason
children.description: 申请退货的原因说明

children.name: skuInfoList
children.description: sku信息列表，必填；需要提供平台sku和申请数量

children.name: platformSku
children.description: 平台sku

children.name: warehouseInfoList
children.description: 仓库列表

children.name: quantity
children.description: 申请退货数量

children.name: warehouseId
children.description: SHEIN仓库id

children.name: warehouseName
children.description: SHEIN仓库名称

children.name: code
children.description: 响应编码，成功：0

children.name: msg
children.description: 错误描述,成功：OK

children.name: traceId
children.description: 请求的唯一标识；用于异常报错跟踪

children.name: returnPlanNoList
children.description: 创建成功的退货申请单列表
